name: net.ferentin.mcp/threat-intel
title: Threat Intel
description: Local IP enrichment MCP server. Exposes GeoIP, ASN, Tor/VPN detection, threat-intel IOC lookup, and impossible-travel detection for log analysis. Fully offline — no outbound network calls.

credential_fields.name: BEARER_TOKEN
credential_fields.label: Bearer Token
credential_fields.help_text: Static bearer token expected in the Authorization header.

tools.name: enrich_ip
tools.description: Return GeoIP, ASN, threat-intel flags, and reputation for a single IP.

tools.name: enrich_ips
tools.description: Batch variant of enrich_ip. Accepts up to 50 IPs per call.

tools.name: check_indicators
tools.description: Check IOCs (IPs, domains, SHA-256 hashes) against local threat-intel feeds.

tools.name: detect_impossible_travel
tools.description: Flag sign-in pairs whose implied travel speed exceeds plausible limits.
